forward_blind_test.claim_cumulative: Cumulative information after N letters per row equals 2^-D * (1 - 2^-N), saturating at 2^-D = 1/8 as N -> infinity.
forward_blind_test.claim_kraft: The geometric ladder is a COMPLETE prefix code on the gravity-coupled subspace; the Kraft sum equals exactly 1/8.
forward_blind_test.claim_per_letter: Letter N (1-indexed) in a multi-letter Paul Revere transmission carries individual capacity 1 / alpha_H^(D+N) = 2^-(3+N) of unit Born baseline.
forward_blind_test.falsifier_cumulative_ceiling: Observed total per-row capacity EXCEEDING 1/8 (after channel calibration) falsifies the gravity-channel ceiling.
forward_blind_test.falsifier_per_letter: An observed multi-letter implementation where letter N has capacity != 2^-(D+N) (differing from the geometric ladder by more than statistical noise) falsifies the geometric subdivision.
forward_blind_test.falsifier_saturation: Observed total per-row capacity SATURATING at a value DIFFERENT FROM 1/8 (by more than statistical noise) falsifies the asymptotic limit identification.
forward_blind_test.non_falsifying: Failure to encode many letters per row in a given implementation does not falsify v1.0 -- it just means the test was not pushed to the channel ceiling.

immutability: Geometric subdivision scaling rule, asymptotic limit identification, and Kraft inequality connection are frozen at CR067a seal time.  Expert review may identify refinements requiring an appeal CR within 12a.

kraft_inequality_connection.interpretation: Complete prefix code on the gravity-coupled subspace (which is 1/8 of full Born unity).  Each letter adds 1 bit of resolution at one deeper closure level.

per_row_vs_per_network_scaling.per_network: linear in row count: total = N_rows * cap_per_row

lock_definition.structural_significance: The N-letter capacity per row asymptotically saturates the Higgs-released gravitational fraction 2^-D = 1/8.  Each letter takes HALF of what remains in the gravity channel.  This is identical to the closure-depth ladder in SAM: letter N requires closure depth D+N = ladder rung at the (D+N)-th binary resolution level.
